intro.text: Captain Brettin, constable-general of the Fourth Octant constabulary precinct in Elendel.
Former constable-general of the Fourth Octant, who retired early and was succeeded by Claude Aradel.

items.text: With several Vanisher robberies happening on his watch, Brettin was under heavy pressure to catch those responsible. Among the first to arrive after the attack on the Yomen-Ostlin wedding dinner, he questioned Wax and told him to keep out of police business and stop undermining his authority.

Wayne, posing as the invented Captain Guffont Trenchant of the Seventh Octant, talked Brettin into letting him question Vanisher prisoners. Because Wayne used a speed bubble, Brettin missed the real conversation and assumed he had learned nothing useful.
To Wax's surprise, Brettin then granted him a citywide deputized forbearance, behavior quite unlike his earlier hostility.

appearance.text: Brettin's face turns noticeably red when he grows angry.

personality.text: Terse and protective of his turf, Brettin will not tolerate civilians meddling in police work or dangerous situations, even when Wax ended a gunfight without a single civilian casualty. He cares deeply about the safety of Elendel's people and knows how much trouble the powerful can cause an investigation.

He carries himself with authority and readily clashes with other constables over jurisdiction, but he is argumentative and short-tempered, and he has a poor memory for names, constantly confusing people.
